description: This file defines patterns and functions for quantization pattern matching and rewriting in PyTorch's JIT compiler, including pattern generation for various quantized operations and their fusion rules.

classes.name: QuantFusionInfo
classes.description: Structure holding quantization pattern matching info including operation name, pattern, replacement, and filters.

methods.name: getExtraArgList
methods.description: Concatenates a list of extra arguments into a comma-separated string.

methods.name: getAtenOpPattern
methods.description: Generates a pattern string for a specific ATen operation with optional scalar arguments.

methods.name: getQuantizeForScalar
methods.description: Creates a pattern string for quantizing a scalar value.

methods.name: getDequantize
methods.description: Creates a pattern string for dequantizing a value.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Creates a pattern string for extracting a scalar item from a tensor.

methods.name: getInputTensorQParamOpPattern
methods.description: Generates a pattern for ops inheriting quantization parameters from input tensor.

methods.name: getInputTensorQParamOpFusionInfo
methods.description: Creates a QuantFusionInfo for ops inheriting parameters from input.

methods.name: getBinaryOpScalarFusionInfo
methods.description: Creates a QuantFusionInfo for binary ops with scalar arguments.

methods.name: getClampOpFusionInfo
methods.description: Creates a QuantFusionInfo for clamp-like operations with scalar bounds.

methods.name: getFixedQParamOpFusionInfo
methods.description: Creates a QuantFusionInfo for ops with fixed quantization parameters.

methods.name: getObservedQParamOpFusionInfo
methods.description: Creates a QuantFusionInfo for ops requiring output observation for quantization parameters.

methods.name: quant_fusion_pattern_and_replacements
methods.description: Returns a list of pattern-replacement pairs for quantized operation fusion.

methods.name: dynamic_quantized_linear_pattern_and_replacements
methods.description: Returns pattern-replacement pairs for dynamic quantized linear operations.

methods.name: dynamic_quant_fusion_pattern_and_replacements
methods.description: Returns pattern-replacement pairs for dynamic quantized operations.

methods.name: linear_prepack_unpack_patterns
methods.description: Patterns for prepacking and unpacking linear layer weights.

methods.name: conv_prepack_unpack_patterns
methods.description: Patterns for prepacking and unpacking convolution weights.
